description: Full-suite run 87776 fails RestartTest with storage_unavailable; isolated restart/onboarding/supervision tests pass (31 tests). Shared BridgeSupervisor is restarted under temporary provider maps by other synchronous tests, so restoring application env does not guarantee provider storage processes exist. Linked-device fixtures must explicitly initialize their required provider runtime before connector operations. Action reuse: reuse JidoChatBridge.start_runtime({:provider, :whatsapp}, []) which delegates existing generic Bridge runtime startup and is idempotent for an existing provider. No new production API or Action. Verify controlled absent-provider reproduction, full restart/onboarding suites, and full gate. Keep async false and preserve storage/confirmation assertions.

comments.text: Controlled reproduction: explicitly stopping provider:whatsapp before the restart test reproduces storage_unavailable at connector startup. Fixed by reusing JidoChatBridge.start_runtime({:provider, :whatsapp}, []) before connector operations, with same provider dependency initialized in onboarding setup. Cold provider bootstrap remains exercised in restart regression. Lifecycle/restart/onboarding/supervision suites: 31 tests pass at seed 87776. mix q passes. Full gate rerunning.

Second full run exposed the same missing provider storage in WhatsAppFullFlowTest setup (three cases), before any message handling. Audited all WhatsAppFlowAdapter/Transport consumers: onboarding, restart and full-flow. Added the same explicit provider bootstrap to the third fixture. This is the same dependency initialization defect, not a message-processing failure.

All three WhatsApp flow fixture consumers now initialize provider storage explicitly. Last full run had only three WhatsAppFullFlowTest setup failures; those now pass in isolation (3 tests), and mix q passes after final edit. The other 10925 tests from that full run passed. Final gate restarted against all fixes.

title: [zaq-10n.11] Initialize provider storage in linked-device integration fixtures
